summary: Add configured Git-only change list, detail and explicit sync commands

replay.detail: No replicated replay, claim kind, binding extension or history scan on database open.

schema.detail: Uses the existing node-local Git change record index.

rules.detail: Opt-in operator configuration selects a controlled repository, exact authorized remote and one discovery owner; requests select only its name. Existing client read.projections list/show and control.work explicit-sync authorization and PR fallback remain.

compatibility.detail: Adds st changes list/show/sync and read-scoped /v1/client/changes, /v1/client/change and explicit sync. Default configuration omits the new changes section for older builds.

downtime.detail: Off by default; no automatic service activation or migration.

manual.detail: Explicit enablement requires a designated reader node, operator-controlled transport clone and named Git credential source outside the workspace. This slice permits reads and explicit indexing only, not pilot creation, stage mutation or pruning.

recovery.detail: Failures keep the previous successful inventory and its timestamp. Unknown, missing and conflicting records remain distinct; explicit sync shares the read budget and validates bounded retained history. Mismatched ref/object identities are skipped and reported without changing another ID's history. Non-owner sync returns a typed unavailable result.
